personal.headline: Programme Manager · Community Systems & Impact Evidence

content.summary: Programme manager with 10 years of experience leading community-centred implementation, strengthening partner systems, and turning field evidence into accountable programme improvement.

experience.title: Programme Manager
bullets: Led a multi-partner livelihoods programme reaching 8,400 participants across 36 communities.
Implemented community-feedback cycles that increased timely issue resolution from 58% to 90%.
Managed 14 partner workplans and improved quarterly evidence-submission completeness to 96%.

experience.title: Monitoring and Learning Officer
bullets: Designed practical monitoring tools used by 22 community facilitators across five programme districts.
Analyzed outcome data that supported a 29% improvement in targeted household follow-up rates.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Development Studies
